correctness.rationale: The two open-neighborhood constraints at each rung are the stated binary not-all-equal constraints. Closed walks in the 16-state transfer with fixed starting position are in bijection with labelled colourings, including n=3; there is no cyclic or graph-symmetry quotient. Independent exact determinant and trace checks reproduced the stated characteristic polynomial and all counts for 3<=n<=30; direct vertex-colouring enumeration gave 20,36,122,400,842,2116,5780 for n=3..9. The frozen script and saved output were inspected and not used as a fresh run. The spectral formula follows regardless of diagonalizability; the two-colour exchange is free. A second, unbounded derivation is given in the prior-implication assessment below.

evidence: The earlier prism record proves the label-preserving neighbourhood correspondence globally. The bipartite prism theorem in Azarija et al. gives a minimum size, not a two-class count; the two other full texts were not retrieved.

evidence: After the earlier reindexing, let B_m count indexed binary cycles of length m with neither 000 nor 111. The four pair states (00,01,10,11) have successor sets (01), (10,11), (00,01), (10). Splitting the transfer into even and odd subspaces for bit complement yields the two blocks [[0,1],[1,1]] and [[0,1],[-1,-1]]. Therefore B_m=L_m+2 cos(2 pi m/3). The reindexing gives A_n=B_(2n) for odd n and A_n=B_n^2 for even n.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For even n, L_n squared equals L_(2n)+2, and 2 cos(2 pi n/3) is 2 if 3 divides n and -1 otherwise. For odd n, applying the same cosine rule to 2n yields the two odd cases. This gives all four frozen formulas and the free-swap division from the known reindexing plus an elementary transfer. No new cyclic structure is required.
